description: Removes a member's vote from a Trello card. The operation requires the member to have already voted on the card; attempting to delete a non-existent vote returns a 400 error. Voting must be enabled on the board.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for removing a member's vote from a card.

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the Trello card from which the member's vote will be removed.
idCard.title: Id Card

idMember.description: The unique ID of the Trello member whose vote will be removed from the card.
idMember.title: Id Member

inputSchema.title: DeleteCardsMembersVotedByIdCardByIdMemberRequest

name: delete_cards_members_voted_by_id_card_by_id_member

DeleteCardsMembersVotedByIdCardByIdMembe.description: Response schema for removing a member's vote from a card. The DELETE endpoint returns a 200 OK status code on success with an empty response body, which is typical for DELETE operations that successfully remove a resource.
